_source: The offers the assistant's Claude layer may mention after it has answered a doubt (docs/assistant.md §11.5; D-59 points 3 and 4). Cowork 10.11.2026. Every row is a fact already on the site or in FACTS.md; the sentence the customer hears is the bank answer named in `faq` (docs/data/assistant-faq.json, verbatim) or, when `dynamic` is set, built from the data file named there — nothing is worded here. families = the doubts a row may follow (price · quantity · choice · quality · timing · delivery). once = at most once per conversation. from / until = the dates between which the lookup returns the row (until = the last day; null = no end). A new promo = the owners' word, dated in FACTS.md, then a row here with its end date. Never returned: in an allergen answer, a complaint, a handoff, or after the customer said no to an offer in this conversation.
never: a discount, code, gift or price that is not a row of this file
stock or scarcity words: nog maar, laatste, op = op, alleen vandaag, bijna weg, doar azi, ultimele, se termină
a countdown or a time pressure other than a row's own date
more than one row in one answer
the same row twice in a conversation
